data.narrative:
Fortastra is a Series B-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Mike Smayda that has raised $8M to date. Our valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of 4 private companies in the same sector and stage cohort (Sierra Space at $8.0B Series C, Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Skyryse at $1.1B Series C), supplemented by 5 public Space & Aerospace comparables trading at a median 24.4x P/S multiple.

Two methods produce applicable results. The stage-progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $75M total-raised proxy, implying a $142M valuation. The peer-median method directly benchmarks against the four same-sector peers, producing a $1.6B median valuation with a range of $1.1B to $8.0B. The public-comp anchoring method is not applicable due to absence of revenue disclosure typical for private companies.

The triangulated valuation range is $121M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $896M. The substantial spread between methods reflects material stage and maturity variance within the peer set—notably, three of four peers are Series C or later. The low anchor rests on stage progression; the high anchor incorporates late-stage peer multiples. Key uncertainties include Fortastra's capital efficiency relative to peers, revenue traction not disclosed here, and whether Sierra Space's $8B valuation represents an outlier or reflects genuine sector tailwinds.
